text:
maria: Heads up — support reported a customer (ACME Corp) missing KMS key-rotation events in their audit feed. We have rotation entries in internal store at 2026-03-12T02:10Z but the customer only saw create/update. Need a quick timeline reconstruction and to confirm if this is a schema/transform bug or RBAC filtering.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1410. Priority P2. Assigned to @maria and @alex. :white_exclamation:

alex: On it. First step: dump audit_events for that customer and the relevant key_id.

alex: Query I'm running:
```
SELECT event_id, event_type, actor_id, actor_role, created_at, payload->>'key_id' as key_id
FROM audit_events
WHERE payload->>'customer_id' = 'acme-123' AND payload->>'key_id' = 'kms-usw-9'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

samir: Results snippet — we see create/update entries but no "rotate_key" types in the time window. Paste: 
```
176f-... | create_key | user:ops | ops | 2026-03-12T02:08:12Z | { ... }
176f-... | update_key | user:ops | ops | 2026-03-12T02:09:03Z | { ... }
```

samir: But our infra logs show KMS rotation RPC at 2026-03-12T02:10:01Z to HSM cluster. So event generation looks like it happened but the audit index lacks the rotation event.

iris: Quick context: yesterday we merged RBAC rename PR #4281 that renamed role "ops" -> "platform-ops" and added a sidecar transform that maps legacy role names for display. Could be filtery behavior in the audit-export transform.

anya: Also landed a small audit schema change last week adding "actor_role" and a version tag on events (schema_version = "v2"). If the export job filters on event_type + schema_version, older rotation events might be rejected by the new validator.

alex: Good call. Running search for raw (unvalidated) events in object store:
```
aws s3 cp s3://audit-raw/2026/03/12/02/ s3-dump/ --recursive --profile infra-readonly
grep -A3 "kms-usw-9" s3-dump/* | head -n 50
```

alex: Found raw event with event_type: "rotate_key" at 2026-03-12T02:10:01Z but schema_version is absent (legacy). The export pipeline's validator requires schema_version == "v2" to surface it to customer feeds.

maria: So pipeline bug: validator is too strict and drops legacy events instead of backfilling or tagging them. We need both a short-term backfill for ACME and a longer-term schema-compatibility fix.

dave: Short-term plan: run the reindex job for that customer for 12-02 02:00-03:00 with a compatibility flag that treats missing schema_version as v1->v2 mapping. I can kick that off. Impact: reindex job will re-emit ~3k events, ETA 18m.

anya: Long-term: update validator to accept legacy events and add an auto-upgrade transform that injects schema_version: "v2" and actor_role mapping using the RBAC map. Add unit tests.

iris: Also check RBAC filtering layer — we had a bug where role rename caused a deny list match because the old string matched a blocklist. If actor_role mapping isn't present, filter rules can incorrectly remove events.

alex: Repro steps for local dev (short):
1) grab raw event JSON from s3 (see s3 key)
2) run `python tools/audit_validator.py --input raw.json --mode dryrun`
3) see it fails with: `Missing schema_version (required v2) -> dropped`

alex: Patch idea: `audit_validator.py` should treat missing schema_version as legacy and call `migrate_legacy_event(raw)` which sets schema_version = "v2" and maps actor_role via `rbac_mappings.json`.

samir: While patch lands, I ran the reindex with compatibility flag and ACME reports getting the rotate_key event now. I pasted the customer-facing event they received (sanitized):
```
{"event_id":"176f-rot-002","event_type":"rotate_key","actor_id":"svc-kms","actor_role":"platform-ops","created_at":"2026-03-12T02:10:01Z","payload":{"key_id":"kms-usw-9","customer_id":"acme-123"},"schema_version":"v2"}
```

maria: Nice. Confirmed with customer — they see the rotation entry and reconciliation passes. Action items: 
- alex: open PR to make validator backward-compatible and add migrate_legacy_event flow.
- anya: add unit + integration tests for legacy v1->v2 migration and RBAC mapping.
- iris: review RBAC denylist and ensure role-rename safe.
- dave: schedule a weekly audit reindex smoke test for customer feeds.

dave: I'll also add a short monitoring alert: if more than 10% of raw events in the last hour are dropped by validator, trigger PagerDuty.

maria: Also flag for docs/product — customer-facing audit schema changed last week; we need to notify enterprise customers and provide migration guidance. @product FYI.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: validator-compatibility-fix -> staging. CI running.

alex: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/audit/compare/compat-v2-migrate (desc + tests). PTAL.

maria: Great work team. Closing incident once validator patch is in prod and ACME confirms reconciliation. :white_check_mark:
